label: dropsEnd: endExport never forwards the write's outcome to the kernel's end, so the run Export started never finishes
refusalIsSuccess: startExport reports true when the kernel's start refuses (no sheet open)
openRefusalIsSuccess: openExport skips the image check, so Export… opens the sheet with no image
find: guard canvas != nil else { return false }

label: runningOpenIsSuccess: openExport reports true over a running write the kernel's begin refuses
dropsChoice: startExport starts on the last choices, not the sheet's
